info.title: Dialpad partner rightbar app contract
info.description: Endpoints a partner rightbar app backend exposes. Paths other than the page are defaults under a configurable prefix (`/dialpad`), which the frontend SDK reads from the page data. The partner's own feature endpoints sit beside these, authenticated the same way, and are not part of the contract.

get.summary: The panel page, served at the app's conversation sidebar URI
get.description: Dialpad frames this URL with `?idtoken=<JWE>`. The idtoken never expires, so partners shouldn't log this endpoint's query string.

200.description: The page, carrying the page data

Content-Security-Policy.description: `frame-ancestors <dialpad origin>; script-src 'self' 'nonce-<nonce>'` plus the partner's asset origin when assets live on a CDN

Referrer-Policy.description: `no-referrer`, so the idtoken in the page URL never leaks

401.description: Minimal error page (`ErrorResponse`): the token does not decode

403.description: Minimal error page (`ErrorResponse`): the partner refuses the user

get.summary: This Dialpad user's connection to the partner's system
get.description: Checked by the SDK on start when the page data says not connected, and while Connect polls.

401.description: The partner's own access token was rejected

post.summary: Disconnect this Dialpad user from the partner's system
post.description: Called from the SDK when the user disconnects, from the app or from Dialpad's panel menu. The SDK then shows the user as not connected.

401.description: The partner's own access token was rejected

get.summary: The partner's CRM OAuth callback (the path is the partner's choice)
get.description: Authenticated by the partner's own OAuth `state`. After storing the tokens, it returns the close-popup page, which posts `close_popup` to the Dialpad origin only when it has an opener, then closes itself.

ErrorResponse.description: Returned with `401` on a bad or missing idtoken and `403` when the partner refuses the user.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

ExternalConnection.description:
The Dialpad user's connection to the partner's system.

The page data carries it so the first paint needs no request, and `<prefix>/ext-connection`
returns it whenever the SDK checks again (on start when not connected, and while Connect polls).

connected.description: Whether this Dialpad user has a working connection in the partner's store
connected.title: Connected

authorization_urls.description: Where Connect sends the user, keyed by OAuth client name. Most apps have one entry; a company with several OAuth clients has one per client. Required when not connected.
authorization_urls.title: Authorization Urls

name.description: The name of the integration's OAuth client, for example `hubspot`
name.title: Name

scopes.description: The OAuth scopes the connection's client has, which apps can gate features on. Empty when not connected.
scopes.title: Scopes

ExternalConnection.title: ExternalConnection

IdTokenClaims.description:
What decoding a Dialpad idtoken returns.

The `csr` claim is dropped while decoding and never exposed, and unknown claims are ignored so new
claims from Dialpad don't break partners. `api_key` is server-side only: `PageData` has no field
for it, and no claim goes into the page.

Not sent over HTTP: what a partner backend gets from decoding the idtoken.

api_key.description: Dialpad public API key for this user and app. Server-side only: never rendered into the page or sent to the browser.
api_key.title: Api Key

IdTokenClaims.title: IdTokenClaims

PageData.description:
Embedded in the page by the partner's backend and read by the frontend SDK.

It carries no user: the SDK asks Dialpad for the user (`get/user`) once it starts.

Carried in the page as `<script type="application/json" id="dialpad-page-data" nonce="...">`, whose JSON is this object plus `"version": 1`. The frontend SDK rejects versions it does not know with `bad_page_data`.

dialpad_origin.description: The Dialpad origin for this environment; the SDK talks only to it
dialpad_origin.title: Dialpad Origin

access_token.description: The partner's own access token for this Dialpad user
access_token.title: Access Token

external_connection.description: The connection at render time, so the first paint needs no extra request

app.description: Partner-defined bootstrap data, passed through as JSON
app.title: App

PageData.title: PageData

accessToken.description: The partner's own access token for this Dialpad user, from the page data
